description: This file defines JavaScript classes and functions for creating a rich text editor toolbar widget within the Yahoo! UI Library (YUI). It includes classes for toolbar buttons, button groups, and the overall toolbar, supporting features like color pickers, spin buttons, drag-and-drop, collapsing, and configurable button types. The code interacts heavily with DOM and event handling, and is part of a larger widget system.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Toolbar
classes.description: A class representing a customizable rich toolbar with buttons, separators, and optional features like titlebar, collapse, and drag-and-drop for use with a Rich Text Editor.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.ToolbarButton
classes.description: A class representing a toolbar button supporting various types (push, menu, select, color, spin) with event handling and customization options.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.ToolbarButtonAdvanced
classes.description: A specialized toolbar button based on YAHOO.widget.Button, primarily used for advanced toolbar button features in the editor.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.SimpleEditor
classes.description: Subclass extending YAHOO.widget.SimpleEditor to provide a full-featured rich text editor with custom command handling, content cleanup, event management, and UI integration using YUI.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Adds a new button to the toolbar, supporting various button types and configurations.

methods.name: addSeparator
methods.description: Adds a visual separator between toolbar buttons.

methods.name: addButtonGroup
methods.description: Creates and adds a group of buttons to the toolbar.

methods.name: addButtonToGroup
methods.description: Adds a button to an existing button group within the toolbar.

methods.name: initAttributes
methods.description: Sets up configuration attributes for the toolbar, including buttons, disabled state, collapsibility, drag-and-drop, and titlebar.

methods.name: _createColorPicker
methods.description: Creates the DOM element for the color picker menu overlay.

methods.name: _makeColorButton
methods.description: Transforms a button into a color picker's color selection overlay.

methods.name: _makeSpinButton
methods.description: Creates a spin control with up/down arrows for numerical input within a button.

methods.name: _getSelectedElement
methods.description: Determines and returns the current selected or focused DOM element within the editor, handling various browser quirks and selection APIs.

methods.name: _getDomPath
methods.description: Builds and returns an array representing the DOM path from the current selected element up to the body, useful for tracking cursor position and context.

methods.name: _writeDomPath
methods.description: Renders a textual representation of the current DOM path into a designated container, aiding in visual feedback and debugging.

methods.name: _fixNodes
methods.description: Cleans up invalid or unwanted HTML nodes (like certain tags) and fixes image and link nodes to maintain clean editable content.

methods.name: _isNonEditable
methods.description: Checks if the event target or its ancestors have the 'yui-noedit' class, and disables editing UI accordingly.

methods.name: _setCurrentEvent
methods.description: Stores the current event object for later reference within editor event handlers.

methods.name: _handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events inside the iframe, manages selection and DOM focus, and fires relevant custom events.

methods.name: _handleMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse-up events to update cursor position and content state after mouse interactions.

methods.name: _handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse-down events, manages selection state, and triggers toolbar button updates for images and links.

methods.name: _handleDoubleClick
methods.description: Handles double-click events to trigger image insertion or link creation UI and update content accordingly.

methods.name: _handleKeyUp
methods.description: Handles keyup events, updates undo stack, and triggers node change updates based on key actions.

methods.name: _handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles keypress events, manages content insertion, and prevents certain default behaviors based on browser.

methods.name: _handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events for commands like undo, redo, bold, italic, lists, insertion, indentation, and special keys, executing corresponding editing commands.

methods.name: _fixListDupIds
methods.description: Ensures list item IDs are unique in the document to prevent duplicate ID issues in browsers.

methods.name: _listFix
methods.description: Manages list indentation and nesting through handling Enter, Tab, Shift+Tab, and other list-related key events.

methods.name: nodeChange
methods.description: Triggers an update of the editor toolbar state, DOM path, and node corrections, optionally with delay.

methods.name: _nodeChange
methods.description: Performs the actual update of toolbar buttons and DOM path, fixing nodes, updating button states and styles based on current selection.

methods.name: _updateMenuChecked
methods.description: Checks a menu item in a toolbar button for given command and value, unchecking others.

methods.name: _handleToolbarClick
methods.description: Executes the command associated with a toolbar button click, handling menu commands and focus.

methods.name: _setupAfterElement
methods.description: Creates accessibility skip headers before and after the iframe for keyboard navigation.

methods.name: _disableEditor
methods.description: Creates an overlay iframe mask to disable the editor and prevent user interaction, optionally restoring the editor.

methods.name: saveHTML
methods.description: Cleans the HTML with the cleanHTML method then places that string back into the textarea.

methods.name: setEditorHTML
methods.description: Loads HTML into the editors body, after cleaning it.

methods.name: getEditorHTML
methods.description: Gets the unprocessed/unfiltered HTML from the editor.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Resets the editor after being hidden, especially useful when the editor was in a tab panel or container with display:none.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the editor, clears timeouts, and moves the iframe off-screen to prevent interference in hidden containers.

methods.name: _cleanIncomingHTML
methods.description: Processes raw HTML to normalize and clean it, including replacing tags, removing scripts, and handling browser-specific quirks.

methods.name: cleanHTML
methods.description: Cleans and normalizes HTML for output, filtering out unwanted tags, fixing list structures, converting tags, and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.

methods.name: filter_msword
methods.description: Filters out MS Word-specific HTML markup and styles, cleaning up Office-generated content.

methods.name: filter_invalid_lists
methods.description: Fixes invalid list nesting markup, converting improper list structures into valid nested lists.

methods.name: filter_safari
methods.description: Filters Safari-specific HTML artifacts, especially those produced by the Apple browser.

methods.name: filter_internals
methods.description: Removes internal editor-specific tags and attributes that shouldn't be part of the final HTML output.

methods.name: filter_all_rgb
methods.description: Converts all rgb() color specifications to hex format.

methods.name: filter_rgb
methods.description: Converts a specific rgb() color string to hexadecimal format.

methods.name: pre_filter_linebreaks
methods.description: Prepares HTML by replacing line breaks and divs with placeholders for further processing.

methods.name: post_filter_linebreaks
methods.description: Converts placeholders back to proper line break tags based on markup type.

methods.name: openWindow
methods.description: Placeholder override method for opening additional editor windows.

methods.name: moveWindow
methods.description: Placeholder override method for moving editor windows.

methods.name: _closeWindow
methods.description: Placeholder override method for closing editor windows.

methods.name: closeWindow
methods.description: Closes editor overlay windows/panels and resets state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the editor instance, cleaning up DOM nodes, event handlers, and restoring original elements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the editor instance.

search-terms: custom command overrides in YUI editor
